decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is close to the core air-cooling offer and cheap to keep listed, and two years of results have not yet shown that its value will not be realized, so the option stays open.
With Product B withdrawn, this remaining single-tube condenser now carries that product family on its own, which lowers the overlap concern, though some risk of portfolio consolidation remains.
The tube liner is a low-cost lifecycle service add-on aligned with the firm's repair and upgrade strategy, so holding the option is cheap while aftermarket demand develops.
The customized air cooler line with several models embodies the firm's integrated custom-solution strategy and offers multiple paths for further investment, making it a valuable option to keep.
The tube end repair inserts support the spare parts and repair business at minimal holding cost, so keeping them preserves upside while demand becomes clearer.
